summary: Global Water Resources, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of 1,129,944 common shares at $8.85 per share, raising approximately $10 million from accredited investors, including directors Jonathan L. Levine and Andrew M. Cohn via affiliated entities. The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No change of control, strategic review, tender, or other special event is involved. The transaction is fully disclosed with standard terms; watch for potential dilution impact on existing shareholders in future disclosures.
